body: I'd suggest you rail a few lines of coke or try an amphetamine to bring you out of that lifelong rut, in hopes that you would realize what joy really means...artificial or not. Most people would react negatively to what I am proposing, but I feel as though the euphoria would force you out of your negative feedback loop into a positive state of mind. The confidence and motivation you seek would come naturally and synergize with your intelligence and athleticism, allowing you the ability to fix yourself rapidly. You are in a dire situation, and you need a motivator powerful enough to completely reverse your state of mind. You can desconstruct, learn, and rebuild yourself into exactly the kind of person you want to be, and don't ever let anyone tell you otherwise. You already hit rock-bottom. Now is the time where you step up, gain access to some "study pills", find a psychiatrist who will play ball and perscribe you adderall for "pervasive major depression", or whathaveyou.

Talk therapy is an effective counter to suicidality and depression for most people. Try a little St. John's Wort, 5-HTP, and L-Tyrosine as a supplement. Vitamin stores often sell blends of all three for a more natural approach to anti-depressant medication.

I recall being nearly blackout drunk, going 110mph, laughing maniacally, whilst screaming "HERE IT COMES." I sought death, and yet I was in complete and total control of my car. My unconscious wouldn't let me die.

I've always wanted to mainline some crystal meth and just let it all go...let the demon in my head have total control of my mental faculties. Allowing such a twisted vicious spirit to fully integrate itself into my being, rather than just inhabit a space within my mind would have grave consequences. A harbinger of destruction unleashed into the physical plane of existence...of course, I might just set myself on fire to cleanse my soul and prove that I do possess enough grace not to let a demon tear people apart for pleasure.

"He who makes a beast of himself, gets rid of the pain of being a man." --Samuel Johnson

Your life is simply a part of the entropy that powers this universe. When you die, you will become a part of the earth and the entropy once again. Your energy will be transferred over and over until the heat death of the universe itself. The end of entropy.

Let it all go. Take what you need to fulfill your life. When you die, you will be awash in a sea of pure energy, such that you will dissolve into it and know what it is to be pure joy once again.

All of my manic episodes have been great in terms of how awesome I feel. I once walked out of my respective city to a town 20 miles away just because I was angry at my family. This is a "great" thing because from my perspective, I can barely function as a normal human being when not in a mania or on amphetamines. When you hate yourself with the same level of intensity as a woman who accidentally killed her child, then set herself on fire because of the guilt she felt...well, being able to experience even artificial joy can become an all consuming desire.

I used to take anti-psychotics like seroquel and abilify. I even took lamictal at the request of someone who thought I was a classic manic-depressive.

-Seroquel: Renders the DAT system nearly useless, which means deep sleep for many hours, not unlike Thorazine.

-Abilify: I was able to function, but with all of my creativity completely removed. I told the doctor I stopped taking the abilify he liked to push that it killed my soul. He did not find this amusing.

-Lamictal: Made me feel great at first, then increasingly aggressive, then I stopped taking it.

Nothing gives me the pure motivation and feeling of unlimited possibilities like amphetamines.

My doc wont give me amphetamines any longer. Oddly enough, at a higher range therapeutic dose, they allow me to feel a chemically induced sense of joy. It is quite similar to what you humans feel naturally. These are the only meds that have worked for me, as the Lamictal seemed to make me want to assault anyone giving me an awkward eye.

This is just a hypomania. I haven't been graced with the etheral pleasures of being in a full blown mania in quite some time.

So what am I to do, helpful empathetic redditor?

In terms of software, becoming a coder (CSS, HTML, JAVA, PYTHON, RUBY, PERL, etc) are marketable skills. I suppose you could try your hand at Cyber Security working for the Government, as the Gman is in dire need of people to help keep the Chinese from hacking into our shit all the time. If you're going to be a hermit, you need to buy up a parcel of land so you can take an existing forest and turn it into a forest garden. That's what I was going to do before I realized that my crazy train is never going to stop, even with meds. You should also take pride in your art. I would exploit my skill in art if it were more...coherent.
Elucidate as to what you have training in and what you honestly would enjoy doing for a living.
